title: The fleet's Desk looks FleetLedger keeps (ship-fleet looks show --json, version 1)
description: What `ship-fleet looks show --json` prints: whether FleetLedger keeps a looks folder for the Herdr Desk (contracts/desk-looks.md), and if so when and from where it was published, its digest and size, and what it names (palettes, presets, tag looks, file names and sizes). Never a file's contents. It only reads, and answers while the vault is locked. See contracts/ship-fleet.md.

stored.description: FleetLedger keeps a looks folder (ship-fleet looks publish); false after looks clear, or before any publish.

problem.description: stored: null when the folder kept is checked and usable; else why it is not (a hand-edited store, or a Desk that no longer offers what a preset names), and nothing else is given.

how.description: folder: a folder on the FleetLedger computer; stdin: a tar stream (from another computer, over ssh).

folder.description: how folder: that folder (~/... when under the home folder); else null.

address.description: The address the ssh session that published it came from, as sshd saw it; null outside an ssh session.

actor.description: The name of the key that session logged in with (as the audit log's actor); null when sshd did not say.

actor_key.description: That key's fingerprint; null when sshd did not say.

sha256.description: One digest of the stored folder: SHA-256 over each file's name, a newline, its length in bytes, a newline and its bytes, files in name order. It changes exactly when what a computer would receive changes.

bytes.description: The stored files' size in all.

presets.description: The folder's preset ids, in its order.

files.description: Every file kept, by name: looks.json, each palette it lists and each logo its presets name. Names only, never contents.
